assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished original game overworld background, a single forest kingdom zone for the landscape home screen of Crownroad, no UI included.
Primary request: a beautiful premium hand-painted fantasy strategy game map with a charming storybook feel, comparable in richness and readability to a polished illustrated tower-defense world map. Create a full illustrated landscape, not a texture swatch and not an empty battle arena.
Composition: wide 16:9, ideally 2048 by 1152. Orthographic birds-eye / elevated isometric cartography with consistent scale. The land fills almost the entire frame. The broad central 80% is an open, explorable meadow and woodland landscape with winding sandy paths, small farms, orchards, rounded tree clusters, gentle terraces, wildflowers, ancient stones, and clearings. Paths connect naturally. Leave varied readable open ground between the scenic details for clickable map markers. A small royal campsite sits in a clearing around 17% across and 44% down. Do not bake in any gameplay markers, banners, characters, caravans, stars, labels or interface.
Environment: King's Road, an inviting verdant medieval kingdom. Tall rugged mountains and a distant limestone keep along the upper perimeter; a turquoise coastline and sandy coves along the lower and left perimeter; leafy emerald forests on the right and upper edges; a couple of stone bridges and peaceful hamlets in the decorative perimeter. Keep substantial water and major impassable cliffs outside the broad central playable land. No giant central castle or empty geometric board.
Art direction: richly painted 2D illustration with crisp purposeful edges, warm sunlight, expressive simplified silhouettes, attractive rounded foliage, detailed miniature houses, lush grass and subtle terrain variation. Saturated emerald and olive greens, luminous turquoise water, honey sandstone, warm ochre paths, blue roof accents, ivory clouds. Light atmospheric clouds only around the outer corners, with the main landscape clear and sharp. Gentle depth and soft painterly shadows. Attractive at both full view and zoom.
Constraints: original artwork, no imitation of exact landmarks from an existing game, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no UI, no portraits, no icons, no visible tile grid, no checkerboard, no repeated dirt texture, no muddy desaturated photorealism, no polygonal diamond-shaped island cutout, no central blank arena.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game UI icon sprite atlas for Crownroad, transparent background.
Create one precisely aligned 3 by 3 grid, nine separate premium hand-painted fantasy game icons. Square canvas ideally 1536 by 1536. Every cell is the exact same size, every icon centered in its cell, all silhouettes contained within the middle 70 percent of the cell, with generous transparent gutters. No grid lines and no background. Do not add text or labels.
Left to right, top to bottom, exact order:
1. A folded parchment adventure map with a small emerald compass jewel.
2. A steel knight's helmet with a blue plume and subtle gold trim.
3. An orange magical fireball swirling around a glowing crimson rune.
4. A heavy silver hammer crossed over a small blue-and-gold shield, for upgrades.
5. A beautiful closed leather encyclopedia with copper corners and a turquoise bookmark.
6. A brown leather traveling satchel holding a tiny scroll and a gold key, for more destinations.
7. A small stack of shining chunky gold coins.
8. A bundle of golden wheat with a small round loaf of bread, for food.
9. A bright five-pointed gold achievement star with beveled edges and an ivory glint.
Art style: polished painterly 2D fantasy mobile game UI; charming bold silhouettes, satisfying sculpted volume, crisp edges, rich saturated colors, warm light from upper left, subtle dark contour, detailed brass highlights. Readable at 48 pixels. Match a lush hand-painted medieval fantasy map. Icons are individual objects, not circular badges or button frames. No extra props, duplicate icons, people, faces, watermarks, lettering, checkerboard, or opaque shadows outside the silhouettes. True transparent background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2 by 2 sprite atlas for a premium hand-painted fantasy overworld game, four equal square cells, aligned exactly to canvas quarters. Match a lush sunlit storybook coastal kingdom with warm honey stone and emerald vegetation, painted miniature scenery from an elevated isometric camera. Exact order: top left, a square swatch of luminous turquoise pond water with subtle depth, soft painted ripples and tiny reflected highlights, fill almost all of its cell with water only, no shore. Top right, a charming cluster of three rounded gray limestone boulders with little moss and grass at the base, no mountain, isolated. Bottom left, a small old wooden footbridge with planks and simple rails spanning diagonally from upper left to lower right, isolated without any water beneath. Bottom right, a small curved clump of emerald reeds with golden tips and a few pebbles at their base, isolated. The water cell can be opaque; all space surrounding the three isolated scenery objects must be truly transparent. Each object stays within middle 70 percent of its cell, generous gutters and no overlap between cells. Cohesive softly painted details and natural shadows, attractive at 60 pixels, no flat polygon style, no hard black outlines, no text, no UI frames, no labels, no grid lines, no checkerboard, no watermarks.
